text:
Hannah: quick FYI - small billing delta in staging. late event (~4m after watermark) created an extra token path. low volume but customer-visible.
Ravi: can you paste a tiny repro?
Hannah: minimal: {"tenant":"tn-A","req":"r-101","tokens":8,"fp":"fp-101","ts":1687000000} we dedupe upstream by fp+req.
Eli: so compact already ran, then late event created new claim and finalizer accepted it?
Hannah: yes. compact snapshot + late tail = duplicate path.
Tess: options: (1) widen compaction slop, (2) keep slop small and make late arrivals emit repair intents handled by audit worker.
Ravi: widening slop increases reporting latency. repair intents add complexity but keep realtime metrics intact.
Eli: suggestion: tiny slop (90s) + repair_intent flow. compactor emits a "compacted" marker; late arrivals referencing that window produce repair_intent instead of credits.
Hannah: repair_intent schema sketch: {"type":"repair_intent","tenant":"tn-A","window":"2026-03-22T11:00Z","fps":["fp-101"],"proof":"s3://proofs/tn-A/.."} worker applies idempotent deltas.
Tess: finalizer should maintain a small recent-fingerprint index (24h TTL) to speed repair resolution. avoid scanning compacts.
Ravi: require CAS on compact snapshot version when applying repair; worker retries on conflict. finalizer emits audit.repair_applied with delta so UI and billing reflect changes.
Hannah: action items: Tess to prototype compactor marker + repair_intent, Ravi to draft finalizer CAS contract and audit event, Eli to add repair delta telemetry and alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: branch metering-repair-intent created and CI started (:white_check_mark:)
Hannah: thanks — prefer small slop + explicit repairs to minimize customer impact. well iterate after staging run.
